kebab_example: aliyun rocketmq run-instance-inspection --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --instance-id rmq-cn-example --client-token inspection-request-001 --api-version 2022-08-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: RunInstanceInspection

parameters.help_en: The ID of the instance. Wildcards are not allowed
parameters.help_zh: 所属实例 ID；不允许通配符
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The idempotency token. The token must be 1 to 64 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, hyphens, and underscores. Retries must use the same token value
parameters.help_zh: 幂等令牌；1～64 位字母、数字、短横线或下划线；重试必须内容一致
parameters.name: client_token

fields.help_en: The parameters for this item, merged by key for the current execution only without being written back. All time-related items must use the same inspection window. The lookback parameter is mutually exclusive with startTime and endTime. Absolute times must be provided in pairs
fields.help_zh: 仅本次执行：按键合并本项参数，不回写；所有时间类项目必须使用同一检查窗口；lookback 与 startTime/endTime 互斥，绝对时间成对提供
fields.name: parameters

fields.help_en: The code of the configured inspection item. This does not select a subset for execution
fields.help_zh: 已配置巡检项编码；不选择执行子集
fields.name: template_code

parameters.help_en: The item overrides for the current execution parameters by key. This does not select a subset for execution. Unspecified items use the saved configuration. If you modify the time range, you must override all time-related items simultaneously and use the same window. Duplicate or unknown items are not allowed
parameters.help_zh: 按键覆盖已配置项的本次参数，不选择执行子集；未指定项沿用保存配置；修改时间范围须同时覆盖所有时间类项目并使用相同窗口；禁止重复或未知项
parameters.name: item_overrides

parameters.help_en: The task ID. This parameter is optional. If you do not specify this parameter, a new execution is created. If you specify this parameter, only the failed report generation for this task is retried without recollecting data. If generation is in progress, the original ID is returned for idempotency. Regeneration is not supported for successful, expired, or deleted tasks. The itemOverrides parameter is not allowed in this mode
parameters.help_zh: 可选；不传创建新执行，传入只重试该任务失败的报告生成，不重新采集。生成中幂等返回原 ID；成功、过期、已删除均不支持重生成；此模式禁止 itemOverrides
parameters.name: task_id

taskId.description_en: The ID of the accepted inspection execution. The HTTP status code is 202
taskId.description_zh: 已接受的巡检执行 ID；HTTP 202
taskId.title_en: 已接受的巡检执行 ID；HTTP 202
taskId.title_zh: 已接受的巡检执行 ID；HTTP 202

v1_body_parameters.help_en: The inspection execution request. You must create an instance inspection configuration first. Use a new value for the clientToken parameter for each new execution
v1_body_parameters.help_zh: 执行巡检请求；须先创建实例巡检配置，clientToken 每次新执行使用新值
v1_body_parameters.name: body
